78379.subject: Robinhood Chain has a breakout app
78379.body:
View image: (https://media.beehiiv.com/cdn-cgi/image/fit=scale-down,format=auto,onerror=redirect,quality=80/uploads/asset/file/04038b52-d7ab-4a85-89e0-c8d2d5534a2c/top_revolut__1_.jpg?t=1788280153)
Follow image link: (https://revolut.ngih.net/n4VPg9)
Caption: 

Welcome to the DefiLlama Newsletter. Each week we bring you the most valuable onchain insights from the the deepest DeFi dataset in the world.

_Gmail users: if this arrived in your Promotions folder, drag this email to your Primary folder._





## Pons Launchpad: a generational run

_“I’ve personally never seen anything like this where we go 0 to 100 in this short amount of time.” — Pons founder_

Tweet:  (https://twitter.com/FullyVested_Pod/status/2094604822439727289?s=20)

Pons is a non-custodial launchpad for fixed-supply tokens on Robinhood Chain.

DefiLlama’s tracked activity starts July 14th when Pons was pulling in ~$150k in daily fees.

A week later, daily fees had already crossed $1m. Yesterday, Pons brought in $4.89m in fees, a 31x increase in seven weeks.

View image: (https://media.beehiiv.com/cdn-cgi/image/fit=scale-down,format=auto,onerror=redirect,quality=80/uploads/asset/file/4e7fc117-a2de-4711-9ee2-aae1bdddd1ba/pons-daily-fees-revenue_2026-09-01.png?t=1788270309)
Follow image link: (https://defillama.com/protocol/pons?revenue=true)
Caption: 

Current data snapshot:

* $31m in 30d fees

* $6m in 30d revenue

* $375m in 30d DEX volume

* 4.03 P/S

* 0.79 P/F

Pons V2 generated the majority of fees and uses a bonding curve for initial token launches that graduate into a Uniswap V4 pool. Fee/buyback split is configurable per token by the creator, but a portion of each launch goes to buying back and burning PONS tokens.

The protocol ranks #2 across the entire Launchpad category in fees earned over the last 30 days, behind Pumpfun.

View image: (https://media.beehiiv.com/cdn-cgi/image/fit=scale-down,format=auto,onerror=redirect,quality=80/uploads/asset/file/d3acf6f1-57a8-4bcd-b17b-e98eef85a54b/30d-launchpad-fees-pons-vs-peers_2026-09-01.png?t=1788270652)
Caption: 

See all tracked launchpads (https://defillama.com/protocols/launchpad)

## fomo: a social trading growth machine

fomo is a mobile-first trading app merging token swaps, social feeds, leaderboards and copy-trading.

The gasless app is crypto’s newest onboarding channel, adding 30,000 new users per day and hosting 1.2m monthly active users in August.

In the last 30 days fomo crossed $1.1b in both DEX and perp volume, more than double each metric MoM. Yesterday, fomo crossed $1m in daily fees for the first time.

View image: (https://media.beehiiv.com/cdn-cgi/image/fit=scale-down,format=auto,onerror=redirect,quality=80/uploads/asset/file/e89f88da-55e4-44ee-87b3-115a76af4670/fomo_2026-09-01__1_.png?t=1788272054)

Bringing global finance onchain



 
Highlights
 
Aave App Enters Early Access on iOS
Early access to the Aave App started on August 26 on iOS. The first cohort of users received Ghost Passes, which are invites that
let friends and family skip the waitlist. More passes are being given out through the Aave Instagram, Telegram, and on X.
Announcement here [https://x.com/aave/status/2092643144139424046].
 
Coinbase Tokenized Stocks Coming to V4
Coinbase Tokenized Stocks went live on Base, and Aave V4 will be the first credit market to fully support them. Once V4 is
deployed on Base, users will be able to borrow stablecoins against tokenized stocks. Only available in eligible geos outside the
U.S. Announcement here [https://x.com/aave/status/2091964981675704495].
 
Aave V4 Crosses $800M Deposits
Aave V4 crossed $800 million deposits on August 27, while active loans set a new all-time high. Announcement here
[https://x.com/aave/status/2093013562788598243].
 
New incentives are also live for USDC borrowers [https://x.com/aave/status/2094433298567090579] in the Core Hub on Ethereum.
Borrow USDC against any available collateral and earn 2% back in USDC rewards.
 
EtherFi Cash Now Runs on V4
EtherFi moved its Cash credit backend to a dedicated Aave V4 instance on Optimism, letting more than 100,000 cardholders borrow
against their portfolios. Supported collateral includes PAXG, SPYx, WBTC, ETH, and ETHFI, with more coming as the integration
expands. Deposits on the deployment crossed $100 million in its first week. Announcement here
[https://x.com/aave/status/2088265181230969095].
